title: About
bio:
I am a security professional working across offensive and defensive security. I have done penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, and SOC work for organizations in finance, telecommunications, aviation, and cloud infrastructure.

Most days move between breaking things and making them hold: testing web, mobile, API, and desktop applications, writing detection rules, and building small tools that make assessments faster. I care about the fix as much as the finding, so I stay with teams until an issue is actually closed.

My vulnerability research has led to a CVE in Oracle Analytics Desktop and to acknowledgements from the U.S. Department of Education, Yamaha Motor, and Norton VPN.

focusAreas.title: Offensive Security
focusAreas.body: Penetration testing across web, mobile, API, thick client, and network targets, including bypassing controls such as WAFs, AMSI, and XDR.

focusAreas.title: Defensive Security
focusAreas.body: SOC operations and threat detection, with custom Sigma and ElastAlert rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

focusAreas.title: Research
focusAreas.body: Vulnerability discovery and responsible disclosure, along with tracking emerging threats and attack techniques.

focusAreas.title: Engineering
focusAreas.body: Internal tools and automation for assessment workflows, plus security work supporting PCI DSS and ISO 27001.
